blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Government engineers are carrying out major repairs to stabilize a landslide-hit mountain highway linking Butuan City in Agusan del Norte and Bukidnon province, a key route expected to boost agricultural trade between Caraga and Northern Mindanao. The road project runs along the Butuan City–Malaybalay road corridor in Tungao, Butuan City, connecting Sitio Danapa to the Lingayao–Lawan-lawan road in Barangay Durian, Las Nieves. The corridor serves as a crucial transport lifeline for the LASBUENASCAR alliance, an economic partnership named after four neighboring towns in western Agusan del Norte: Las Nieves, Buenavista, Nasipit, and Carmen.
